messages.subject: Error: Continuous variable () supplied to discrete scale_hue.
parts:
I want to have two layers where the colour scales are different, i.e.
continuous in 1 and discrete in the other.

This is a simple example

## this works
d <- ggplot(diamonds, aes(carat, price)) + stat_binhex()

## a new layer with discrete scale
quad=data.frame(x=c(1,5,1,5), y=c(5000, 10000, 10000,5000),
fill=factor(1))
d+geom_polygon(aes(x,y,fill=fill),data=quad1)

Is there anyway to do this?

Thanks Laurie
